s176.sec7.u0: Oh yeah! Is your bag too full? Boing! They say somewhere in the world there's a key chain that links your bag to another dimension, so you can carry more items! Maybe go back around the places you've already been!
s176.sec7.u1: I'll teach you my top secret item-buying tips! In the item list, press the Start button to see what an item does! When you choose how many, {color 4}□{color 1} picks as many as you can afford, and holding {color 10}○{color 1} with up or down changes it ten at a time! When the list is long, hold R1 and press up or down to scroll fast! And one more secret... Try buying something right after your Digimon is reborn! Something good is sure to happen! Boing!
